title: ConvertAPI (file conversion)
description: ConvertAPI as a way for System Hooks to convert files: Word, PDF, images and hundreds of other formats, converted by an API instead of a program on this machine. Declared as a service you can test and fix from Admin > Connectors.
setup_notes: Get an API token at convertapi.com (Authentication; new accounts come with free conversions). Run Test on its row under Admin > Extensions > Connectors, which converts a small picture from PNG to JPG. Then, under Admin > Capabilities > System Hooks, Adapt a job (or add a format of your own) and set Done by to this connector: the file is sent to ConvertAPI and what comes back is checked like any converter's result. Files leave this machine for ConvertAPI's servers; keep that in mind for what agents read. ConvertAPI counts conversions in seconds of its time, so no price is declared. Its key is given where it is used, under the choice, or under Settings on its row in Admin > Extensions > Connectors.

questions.name: name
questions.label: Connector name
questions.help: Lowercase letters, digits, dashes and underscores; System Hooks lists it by this name.

config.name: api_key
config.label: API token
config.help: Kept with this connection, and sent only to the address it is given for.
